source: Outlook review of ben@sandpiperre.com (read-only), 2026-11-10 ~10:30am MT → 2026-11-11 ~9am MT. Automated run; no LOI search. All folders swept (~100 messages) plus calendar through 11/20. Updates on 106th, 281 Fogg, 6371 Nesbitt, 715 Valley, 2400 S 14th; two new Tracking deals (2045 W Union, 4950 W Watkins). Central 70 IOS flyer (CBRE via Aviva, Denver) has no asking rent ('negotiable'), so not queued as a comp. One sale comp from IOS List (5790 Rogers St, Las Vegas).

status: CLOSING FRIDAY 11/13 (Burke 'Close Date' hold 11am MT). Seller's attorney Craig Johnson sent a working draft Special Warranty Deed 11/11 and needs the buyer's address; Westbrook signs as Manager of Precision. Closing will be electronic (Ben to Pat Boyle 11/10).

Loan: FIB loan amount $2,924,000 per Christina Cole to Fidelity (11/10). Lender counsel Tim Shea (RWO) sent lender's-policy instructions to Fidelity 11/10. Essex circulated revised loan docs with lender counsel's comments late 11/10 (not yet reviewed by Essex). Ben signed the FIB Treasury DocuSign 11/10. Schuster (11/11) asked Polsinelli to confirm sign-off on the consents and closing certificate.

JV docs: Polsinelli sent further revised JVA + Cross Indemnity 11/10. SPC's Wyoming LLC is formed; Schuster sent Schedule 8.2(b) (SPC owned by Sandpiper Capital LLC, owned by Ben). Ben sent Exhibits A ($1.6M CP Fund I / $177,777.78 Sandpiper = $1,777,777.78, 90/10) and B (business plan) 11/10. Polsinelli declined Ben's 90/10 footnote on Exhibit A (JVA mechanics govern). Still open from CPP: accounting confirmation and Knowledge designees.
Insurance: CCIG (Erica McCaa) says the $41,000 premium wrongly included higher sewer and O&L limits; underwriter is reducing coverage back to the original quote (11/10). Ben thought it was ~$25K.
Post-close: RIO Real Estate will manage (Chad Murray intro 11/10; Nick Bhakta as manager, Melinda Robertson runs commercial). They want a site visit next week after closing.
Ben owes: buyer address for the deed (Craig); TD-1000 (Ben said 11/10 he will complete it); revised insurance premium check; site-visit day/time to RIO.

PSA: Ben and Schuster finished the seller's redline 11/10; comments back to JLL are 'very minimal'. Schuster was tied up with other closings but aimed to turn it the night of 11/10. Chris Burns (JLL) pushing on timing.
Price $14.5M per Ben (11/10); likely closing with the CPP team again (fund or another vehicle TBD).
Timeline per Ben: 45-day DD / 15-day close, closing around the week of Jan 11. EM: $25K at PSA, $75K more at lease signing, $100K more at go-hard (11/4).
Insurance: Morgan Mahoney (CCIG) reviewing the docs; more needs late this week or early next (11/10).
Seller won't let buyer into the Carvana lease talks; Ben agreed to remove PSA §11(d). Environmental: AEI 2021 Phase I passed to True North; AEI to start once under contract.
CONSTRUCTION. Owner: Verona IOS LLC. GC: TJK. On track for early December completion.

Pending Ben's decisions (TJK, 11/10): Building 4 power + interior/exterior lighting $7,006; Building 2 exterior lighting at the dark south end, where Ben is suggesting 3 lights for about $2,300. Ben's own notes 11/10: 2 gas unit heaters for the Building 1 shop at about $19,000 (inferred estimate).

Data center angle: Alliant Energy (Brad Hougaard → Amber Rodgers) sent its data-center intake form and NDA 11/11. Bryant Meyer (Oakbrook) will get feedback from the prospective data center user before going further. Ben and Meyer have a 'Nesbitt Rd Discussion' call 11/11 at 2pm MT.
Leasing: slow; RFPs out to Congruex and Rent a Fence (11/6). Ben on site Dec 10–11.
Seller won't get to Ben's $1.7M (Dave Faris, SRS, 11/10). He plans to list 715 Valley at $2.1M with his own agent; Faris asked for Ben's best number before it hits the market.
Ben replied 11/10: 'Not with this clear height, I'm tapped out.' Effectively passed (inferred); left at LOI Submitted since nobody called it dead.
Seller countered $2,205,000 on 10/26. USS leaves March 2027.
Payton Kruidenier (Ross Brown) spoke with the owner (Jeff) for over an hour 11/10; wants a call with Ben 11/11. He hasn't put Ben's offer in front of the owner yet.

Tenant Knapheide's 5-year lease ends Jan 18 (2027, inferred); they're moving to a new West Valley facility but asked to stay to July 2027. Knapheide still wants to buy: the seller gave them a number with a Dec 1 deadline, said to be a little above $6MM.
Seller will sell whether or not Knapheide buys; prefers Knapheide, all cash. Seller carry not ideal. Broker Max Schumacher is '1a', Sandpiper '1b'.
Risk: the north lot is zoned residential.

Off-market via Kyle Benson (Malman Real Estate) after a call with Ben, 11/10. Asking $6,747,138 ($231.55/SF), 6.5% cap; 29,139 SF on 6.779 ac. Site plan, rent roll and operating statement attached to his email.
Seller (family, father's estate split among siblings) must net $6.5M after commissions and says not to offer below $6.5M. If buyer pays the commission, gross price could get closer to $6.5M.
Much of the income is from yard space. Benson sees modest upside from marking warehouse rents to market and knows the tenants in the neighboring portfolio.
Value-add Phoenix deal; Nigel Keep (Kidder Mathews) sent the OM 11/10.
Ben 11/10: loves the deal and location, has been working with Kidder Mathews on it for a while, but 'BIG PRICE'. No price pulled from the OM in this sync.
